name: comp-461
title: Grouped Pagination
description: A single pill-shaped pager whose cells hold a back chevron, pages 1 to 4, an ellipsis and a forward chevron, split by thin borders with the current page shaded.
use: A compact footer where the page controls should read as one unit, like a toolbar.
avoid: When the row must wrap on a phone: it is a single non-wrapping bar of cells.
a11y: Chevrons are labelled and focus is visible on cells; the hover fills have no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One long rounded bar on black is divided into bordered cells: a left chevron, pages 1 to 4, a three-dot ellipsis and a right chevron, with only the outer ends rounded. The active page cell is filled a shade lighter than the rest.
behaves: Hovering a cell fills it grey while the current page keeps its shading. The demo holds the page at 3, so the joined bar never changes width.
customise: Pass currentPage, totalPages and the slot count; the joined outline cells, dividers and rounded outer ends are fixed classes.
weight: light: A single row of outlined cells; only hover fills and active shading.
